text: Developers can inspect any part of a design and grab needed info anytime, via a free web browser view without needing a Mac or the Mac app.
quote: they won’t even need the Mac app (or a Mac) as it all happens in a web browser

text: Sketch plugins can be written in JavaScript (ES6), accessing macOS frameworks and Sketch APIs without needing Objective-C or Swift.
quote: Write a Sketch plugin in JavaScript. Take advantage of ES6, access macOS frameworks and use the Sketch APIs without learning Objective-C or Swift.

text: Developers can test the Sketch JavaScript API interactively directly within the app.
quote: Try the Sketch JavaScript API now, directly within Sketch.

text: The sketchtool command-line interface lets you create assets with a single command.
quote: Create assets with a single command with the Sketch command-line interface `sketchtool`.

text: Sketch can be integrated into workflows and server applications on any platform.
quote: Integrate Sketch into your workflows and server applications, on any platform.

text: The sketch:// URL scheme lets you trigger Sketch actions from other workflows.
quote: Integrate Sketch into your workflows with the `sketch://` URL scheme.

text: Designers can create hotspots/links to navigate between frames or trigger overlays in prototypes.
quote: Create links or Hotspots to navigate between different frames or trigger Overlays.

text: Editing a Symbol updates every instance of it across the design automatically.
quote: When you make changes to a Symbol, those changes appear everywhere you use it in your designs.

text: Starring a version publishes it as a Library update; unstarred versions afterward don't propagate.
quote: starring a version will publish any changes as a Library update. Any unstarred versions after that won’t become Library updates.

text: Shapes can be combined non-destructively via Union, Subtract, Intersect and Difference boolean operations.
quote: Create a new shape from two or more shapes with non-destructive boolean operations — Union, Subtract, Intersect and Difference.

text: Shapes support fills, borders, drop shadows, inner shadows, and bitmap layer effects.
quote: Apply a fill, border, drop shadow, inner shadow or bitmap layer to a shape.

text: A companion mobile app lets you view documents, play prototypes on a real device, and mirror your Mac design live.
quote: View your documents on the go, play prototypes on a real device, and mirror designs as you edit them on your Mac.

text: Light mode components can be automatically swapped for dark mode counterparts without manual changes.
quote: Switch light mode components for their dark mode counterparts — all without making a single manual swap.

text: Drop in a photo to auto-generate a full set of named, ready-to-use color variables.
quote: Drop in a photo and get a full set of named color variables that complement it.

text: An AI client can point at a repo to recreate text styles, colors, components, and whole pages inside Sketch.
quote: Point your AI client at a repo to recreate text styles, colors, UI components, and even entire pages inside Sketch.

text: Any frame can be built out in code with 1:1 visual fidelity.
quote: Take any frame in Sketch and build it out in code with 1:1 visual fidelity.

text: Any MCP-compatible AI client can connect to Sketch with no extra tokens, tiers, or add-ons required.
quote: Connect any MCP-compatible AI client you like to Sketch. There are no tokens to buy, no extra tiers, and no add-ons.

text: SCIM provisioning is supported for automated user account management.
quote: SCIM provisioning

text: Permissions groups let admins control access levels for users.
quote: Permissions groups

text: Documents are stored in an open .sketch format — a zipped archive of JSON and binary data.
quote: Sketch stores documents in .sketch format, a zipped archive of JSON formatted data and binary data such as images.

text: Nested Symbols give finer control over complex, layered designs.
quote: Nested Symbols give you finer control over complex designs.

text: Prototypes support overlays, hover/press/toggle triggers, and scrolling areas to simulate real interactions.
quote: With features like overlays, hover, press and toggle triggers, and scrolling areas, you can accurately show how your designs would work in the real world

text: Layers can be automatically sorted, renamed, and aligned in bulk to keep files organized.
quote: Sort, rename, and align layers automatically. Wrangle icon sets, keep Libraries clean, and bring calm to chaotic files.

text: Starred versions let you mark milestones, control what Viewers/Guests see, and decide which become Library updates.
quote: With starred versions, you can indicate important updates in a document's history, set which versions Viewers and Guests can see

text: The skpm CLI tool lets developers publish new plugins or updates to existing ones.
quote: Use the Sketch Plugin Manager `skpm` to publish a new plugin or an update of an existing one.

text: Symbols let you save and reuse common design elements across files to speed up workflow.
quote: Symbols can speed up your workflow by giving you a way to save and reuse common elements across your designs.

text: Placeholder text can be replaced across every layer with context-aware, realistic content instead of lorem ipsum.
quote: Replace placeholder text across every layer with true-to-life, context-aware content. No more lorem ipsum.

text: SSO and SCIM provisioning setup guides are documented for enterprise identity management.
quote: Learn how Single Sign-On (SSO) and SCIM provisioning work in Sketch, and find step-by-step guides to get set up.

text: An official vanilla JavaScript plugin API is fully supported and stable across releases.
quote: An official vanilla JavaScript API, fully supported between releases.

text: Plugins can be installed manually by moving them into the Plugins folder.
quote: you can install plugins by simply moving them into the Plugins folder yourself.
